R4 — real market cost (operator SAVE-FEEDBACK on Simulate v4: APPROVE WITH CHANGES — "Cube cost seems high; UX IS WAY BETTER", "ensure costs are real market costs"): DEFAULT_SECTIONS recalibrated to $240,000 (≈$267/ft², the ICON-market target he chose); a $/ft² readout on every card; the Tiny holds ~$40k through a fixed Trailer & appliances floor (fixedUsd, reconciled as its own row); labor $ = hours × rate shown (laborHoursFor · laborRateFor, ~$28/hr). Tests re-pinned (architect-estimate 240000; architect-sim-options 234/0). Shipped 82debfc45.

HI decisions taken on the Simulate v4 feedback and the SoI-2525 direction (AskUserQuestion, persisted at docs/asks/2026.10.30_22.09..33_architect2525_hi_decisions_r4_r5.md): (1) the Cube's target is ~$240k (his words: ≈$265/ft², the ICON market; $240,000 ÷ 900 ft² computes to $267/ft², the figure the card shows) — executed by 82debfc45; (2) the volunteer Tiny keeps ~$40k through a fixed trailer + appliance floor — executed by 82debfc45; (3) the Site map pin marks the Abuja pilot site; (4) design-first is a methods × (cost · time · elements) matrix — Frame · Steel · Concrete · 3D-print side by side BEFORE a build method is chosen (R7); (5) the pilots Austin · Mexico City · Abuja are example data on the Architect project only — the Atlantis Accord is NOT touched ("no need to update atlantis accords; this is example"). On R4 itself (APPROVE WITH CHANGES): "$240 is good target price"; "Material cost must be covered" → "Costs should always include minimally full hours of staff needed to complete the job. Upside is if we have volunteers. Never make materials zero" (R6); "ensure no disconnects from this and rest of architect 2525" (R6, one cost truth); the "3 → 6 decisions" remark was an observation only.

HI decisions the R5 ship executes (persisted verbatim at docs/asks/2026.10.30_22.09..33_architect2525_hi_decisions_r4_r5.md): (1) Room Designer decision card — PROCEED · Layout A · simplify S1 · "No dresser; place that in other room. Table / vanity with mirror works"; repeated on the live site's busy bedroom: "stop reverting; this is why you have R-Core: we already said this is too busy" → the Master Bedroom default is a DECIDED standard layout (no dresser, no wardrobe — both live in the Master Closet), the designer opens SIMPLE with the CAD chrome behind ⚙ Advanced, and the whole decision is R-CORE-LOCKED by tests/room-standard-layout.test.mjs in test:ci. (2) "ensure GPS WORKS AS WELL" → the root cause is the site-wide Permissions-Policy geolocation=() header, fixed as a class to geolocation=(self) and gated. (3) "/main/Architect-2525/ must post to /Architect-2525/. Main should never be used anywhere. /main is the same as the site root" → one Worker 301 for /main and /main/*, the canonical /Architect-2525/ route, app/main removed, gated. (4) "minimally this needs to be 3x3 design" → Build 4D draws the canonical 3×3. (5) "ensure R-CORE is being updated" → every revision ships with its ledger row; the Simulate v4 → R4 ships were backfilled (rev 5–12). Executed by f299909b9.

R5 — the live site, fixed now: the Master Bedroom opens as the decided standard layout in a SIMPLE Room Designer (lib/room-objects.ts STANDARD_LAYOUTS.M + standardLayoutFor; ROOM_ASSETS.M without dresser/wardrobe, with desk; room-designer.tsx simpleMode default + ⚙ Advanced; the name badge re-homed for Simple) with ONE placement convention across every view (worldSpan — the room designer, the house plan, the house voxel and the packer; the WireGuard keeps half-foot centres); GPS works (public/_headers + worker.js geolocation=(self); architect-skysun locate() with honest branches; the pod GPS error logged); /main is never used (worker.js 301 /main[/x] → /[x] keeping the query; app/Architect-2525 canonical + /design; app/main/** removed; _redirects lowercase → /Architect-2525/; 14 app references purged; tests, CI probe and scripts re-pointed; ledger routes + registry on root routes); Build 4D draws the canonical 3×3 step by step (architect-build.tsx over TINY_ROOM_LAYOUT); the R4 card's untrue "the same hours drive the Build-Instructions crew-days" clause trimmed; two react/no-unescaped-entities lint errors from 2026-10-28 fixed so next build passes.
